threads.body: When `hasRoute` is true, `httpAttributes` are left untouched (implicitly relying on `HttpServerTestOptions` defaults). To make the test setup deterministic and resilient to future default changes, consider explicitly setting attributes in both branches (e.g., `DEFAULT_HTTP_ATTRIBUTES` when `hasRoute` is true, and `DEFAULT_HTTP_ATTRIBUTES` minus `HTTP_ROUTE` when false).

The boolean parameter name `hasRoute` is a bit ambiguous because it actually controls whether `HTTP_ROUTE` is included in expected HTTP attributes. Renaming it to something more explicit (e.g., `includeHttpRouteAttribute` / `expectHttpRouteAttribute`) would make call sites and the `if (!hasRoute)` condition easier to understand and reduce mistakes when adding new tests.

`hasRoute = true` already preserves the default HTTP attributes, but this helper still immediately resets them to `DEFAULT_HTTP_ATTRIBUTES` below. That leaves the Akka tests with the redundant reset this PR removes from Pekko; remove the `setHttpAttributes` block here as well.
